mentions.name: Screen-Free Offline Café
mentions.description: A dedicated offline café space where patrons store screen devices in lockers; it serves coffee, beverages, and light food, with a small separate area available for occasional screen/internet access when needed.
mentions.source_excerpt: Working on an dedicated offline space.  Screen device are stored to a locker.  Serves coffee and beverages and light food. (There will be a small separate space for occasional screen/internet access in case of need)
